accept.specs:
spec fn ref_pre(a: &[i64], d: i64) -> bool { a.len() <= 1000000 && -1000 <= d && d <= 1000 && (forall|k: usize| k < a.len() ==> -1000 <= #[trigger] a[k] && a[k] <= 1000) }
spec fn ref_post(a: &[i64], b: &[i64], d: i64) -> bool { a.len() == b.len() && (forall|k: usize| k < a.len() ==> #[trigger] a[k] == b[k] + d) }
